main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he has no fight booked, expects to return in December, and would love to fight Topuria though no conversations have taken place.
note: Pimblett's own story: 'he would love to fight him but added that no conversations have taken place' is a wish for a fight with Topuria, so the article adds nothing new about Topuria and the fact is no_fact. Act could be none_of_these since Pimblett mostly talks about his own return and lists several other names.

main_claim: Brendan Schaub thinks the UFC will make Ian Machado Garry's road back to a title shot hard, possibly by booking him against bad matchups such as Yaroslav Amosov.
note: Amosov appears only in the closing lines of a Garry story as 'a dominant grappler whom a lot of fans still aren't aware of', 'a nightmare matchup' Schaub believes the UFC might book; Schaub is a former heavyweight fighter, so other_fighter_side. Centrality could be one_of_several given the two sentences assessing him, and the act could be none_of_these since the Amosov line is mainly a forecast of what the matchmakers will do.

main_claim: Sean O'Malley's coach Tim Welch says there are rumours of a Pimblett vs Topuria fight in December, and O'Malley leans slightly toward Pimblett.
note: 'Hay rumores de un Paddy Pimblett contra Topuria en diciembre', from a named coach with a month, is a rumour of a specific fight of his, so next_fight at rumour; the article is built around Topuria's return. O'Malley's 'me inclino por Paddy' makes predicts_his_fight a reasonable act, and Pimblett shares the stage enough that one_of_several is arguable.

main_claim: Topuria, in quotes gathered from earlier interviews, recounts his hard childhood in Georgia without his parents, the bullying he faced, and the values and relationship with fear that shaped him.
note: His own words on family and childhood ('a los ocho años mis padres nos tuvieron que dejar', 'Nos acosaban en la escuela') are the whole article, so personal_life stated by himself; the sub-headers about his next fight and his agent are read-also furniture and 'no ha vuelto a hablar desde que fuera derrotado' is background. Fact could be no_fact since the quotes are recycled reflections from older interviews rather than new happenings.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje, discussing his future as champion, says he does not plan to retire yet and would like to fight Conor McGregor, mistakenly framing it as a rematch.
note: Gaethje's own story; Topuria appears only as background ('won the title in June over Ilia Topuria', 'since Topuria beat them') and in the writer's rankings aside, so Gaethje, who has fought him, talks about himself and McGregor and does nothing regarding Topuria: act none_of_these. Centrality could be one_of_several because the June fight is the premise of Gaethje's status, but it is never discussed.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris, dominating rounds one and three, and then called out Daniel Rodriguez.
note: A round-by-round account ending in 'Official decison: Daniil Donchenko defeated Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28)' is a fight report, so result, done; the Rodriguez callout is a wish, so next fight no, and it is only described, not quoted, so he_speaks no. Source himself / act speaks_of_himself is arguable for the callout, but the result is the main claim.

main_claim: Donchenko convincingly beat Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris, dominating but failing to finish, and called out Daniel Rodriguez afterwards.
note: The piece narrates the rounds and gives the cards ('Офіційні картки – 30–27, 30–27 і 29–28 для Донченка'), so result, done; the writer's verdict that he 'could have done better' makes media / assesses_him a reasonable alternative. His pre-fight quotes ('Він сильніший за всіх моїх попередніх суперників...') are quoted at length but recalled from before the fight, so he_speaks could be read as no; the Rodriguez callout is a wish, next fight no.

main_claim: Usman Nurmagomedov denies in an Instagram statement that he wanted to elbow Song Yadong after Umar Nurmagomedov's knockout loss at UFC Shanghai.
note: Topuria appears only in a 'LATEST NEWS' link about Gaethje's hands, which is page furniture, so not_in_content; the article's own content is Usman Nurmagomedov's statement, hence other_fighter_side, and nobody does anything regarding Topuria, so act none_of_these.

main_claim: UFC Paris results: Salahdine Parnasse knocked out Dan Hooker in the main event, with Daniil Donchenko beating Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision on the main card.
note: A results page where his bout is one line, 'Daniil Donchenko def. Punahele Soriano via unanimous decision (30-27 x2, 29-28)': only_mentioned, but his bout on a results page is result, done.

main_claim: The writer's UFC power rankings after Fight Night 286 keep Makhachev first and drop Topuria to fifth after his loss to Gaethje.
note: Topuria is one entry in a ten-fighter ranking, with his June loss retold as background ('has slipped to fifth on this list after losing badly'), so only_mentioned and no new fact; the writer's 'his god-like complex got in the way' is an assessment, though none_of_these is arguable for a ranking entry. The removed '18-0' X status is a trivial aside, not the main claim.

main_claim: Paul Hughes, twice beaten by Usman Nurmagomedov in PFL, says Topuria is the only UFC fighter with a chance against Usman should he sign with the promotion.
note: Hughes's 'la única persona en la UFC en este momento que tiene una oportunidad contra Usman es Topuria' rates Topuria's level, an opinion, so no_fact; Usman is not booked against him, so Hughes and Abdelaziz are other_fighter_side. The article is as much about Usman's free agency as about Topuria, so main_subject or only_mentioned could both be argued.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev's coach Javier Méndez, interviewed about Makhachev's camp and Joel Álvarez, says Topuria has the best boxing in MMA and will come back stronger after his loss to Gaethje.
note: Most of the interview is Makhachev, Álvarez and Usman; Topuria gets the closing questions with opinions only ('tiene el mejor boxeo', 'creo que va a volver muy fuerte', the eye damage was the key), so no_fact from the coach of a fighter not linked to a fight with him. The headline makes main_subject arguable, and the absence of any new fact about him makes only_mentioned arguable.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says Topuria is enjoying life, is well and will come back to reclaim the belt, as the article recounts his summer appearances after the Gaethje loss.
note: Merab, a friend and fellow fighter, says 'se lo está pasando en grande. Está disfrutando de la vida... y se encuentra bien', and the article lists his cinema outing with his son and parties, so personal_life reported by a third party; 'se encuentra bien' is a named person's statement of how he is beside it, so health yes. Fact could be health or status_update, and health could be no because the '(físicamente)' is the writer's gloss and the fractures and suspension are recapped as background.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and the UFC is ready for him, but nothing is scheduled and no decision has been made between a Gaethje rematch and a Pimblett fight.
note: 'We don't have him on the schedule right now. Listen, Topuria's ready to fight, we're ready for him' from the UFC CEO is where he stands with no specific fight, so status_update, official; Gaethje and Pimblett are named only as options and the 'rumors swirling' line has no who or when, so next fight no, though an editor could count it. His quoted post 'we are back!' is three words, so he_speaks could be read as no; 'recovered from a multitude of injuries' is the writer's recap, health no.

main_claim: Jorge Masvidal, Amosov's American Top Team teammate, says Amosov is a bad fight for everyone including champion Islam Makhachev and touts him as a future welterweight champion.
note: Masvidal's 'He's a bad fight for everybody. Even Makhachev... Nightmare for Makhachev' is an assessment of his level from a teammate, which the guide counts as other_fighter_side; his Magny and Alvarez wins are recapped as background and 'is due for a big fight next time out' is the writer's opinion, so no_fact.
